title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-14
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with buzzing/mix problems on the electric set, but an outstanding acoustic portion highlighted by a rare How Long Blues and a David Crosby guest jam.
ai_review.review: The acoustic half of this show shines – crisp banter, a rare rendition of "How Long Blues" and a special guest spot from David Crosby make it a keep‑list favorite. The electric set suffers from mix and buzzing issues, with some songs sounding distant or cut, though moments like the China > Rider segue and a thick‑drummed "The Other One" still stand out. Overall the tape is listenable for fans who can overlook the technical flaws in the second half.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings, praising the acoustic set while noting clear problems with the electric mix; the show is solid but recording issues keep it from higher marks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Acoustic portion clear and enjoyable; electric side plagued by buzzing, mix problems and occasional cuts (e.g., "Casey Jones" distant, "Easy Wind" cut).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set flows strongly with rare material and guest jam; electric set is uneven, missing "Frozen Logger" and showing inconsistent energy despite a few high points.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir takes his time on the lyrics of "El Paso", giving it a unique feel.
band_member_comments.Drums: "The Other One" features thick‑nice drums reminiscent of the 1970 era.
